name: Grande Centre Point Voyage Pattaya
detail: The newly opened hotel offers modern amenities that are excellent in every aspect. The king-size bed is large and comfortable enough for a parent and two small children to sleep together (we didn't even use the sofa bed provided by the hotel). The sea view is beautiful from both sides. There are many activities to do, and we happened to visit during a long holiday. Parking is limited, so we chose to dine in the hotel. The front area, Brooks Brunch and Bars, is really great. The food is delicious, the music is nice, and the service is good. The price is worth it. If you want to reserve a table at the rooftop restaurant, it's recommended to book from check-in because tables fill up very quickly, especially during long holidays.

name: Sunday Beachfront View Jomtien Pattaya
detail: I like the location and can choose budget-friendly days on Agoda. If you come early, you often get a sea view room (recommended for level 5 and above). Room B 803 is a small room, so there is no large daybed and no balcony (rooms ending in 03, 04). Odd-numbered rooms have a sea view. The advantage is that you can enjoy the beautiful sea view from the bed. In the afternoon, the sun comes in, and sometimes the small air conditioner can't handle it. The bathroom shows signs of long-term use, which is acceptable. But be cautious of the slippery floor due to standing water, as some spots are not sloped towards the drain. The area around the swimming pool would be excellent if improved and well-maintained because the view is very beautiful. For breakfast, if the bread section could be improved in quality and offer more options, including jams and margarine, it would be greatly appreciated. In summary, I love the sea view, so I overlook other shortcomings.

name: Sunday Wongamat Privacy Pattaya
detail: The room is very large, 50 square meters, with a wide balcony. It's fairly clean for an old building. The bed is comfortable, the blanket is cozy, and the sheets are clean, but the pillowcases have a slightly musty smell. The bathroom has a bathtub separated from the shower area, and the water pressure is good with both hot and cold water available. There is a king size bed and a single bed in the room, along with one long sofa, which can comfortably accommodate up to 4 people per room. The staff are very nice, and my mother liked it a lot because the room is spacious. It’s an old room in an old building, but there's nothing scary about it. The atmosphere is good and suitable for relaxation.

name: Pooh Beach Resort & Spa
detail: (Pros) Good water pressure. Hot water is great. Smart TV Individual air conditioning Slippers Umbrella Safe available (Knowledgeable) Staff are friendly Pool water is well maintained. Rooms are spacious. Breakfast can be enjoyed deliciously for about 3 days. The bed was comfortable. It was nice to have a sofa and table. The resort atmosphere is quite good. The beach is close. (Cons) There is a smell from the drains. In the entrance alley There are many bars trying to attract men, which may not be suitable for family trips... The rooms are somewhat dated. Overall Best value for individual travelers. Recommended! Not so much for couples or families... However... considering the price, it's not bad.

name: April Suites Pattaya
detail: Advantages: The location is good. The room is relatively clean. I like that there is a rooftop pool. The male staff at the reception are friendly. Disadvantages: The bedding feels damp. It can be a bit cold at night. I turned off the air conditioning, but there's still air conditioning flow from somewhere. I stayed in room 315, and the balcony door doesn't lock, which is unsettling. The room is on the small side. You can hear noises from the hallway, sounds of people passing by, closing doors, and voices from the next room. Internal noise can be heard until late at night. There isn’t much external noise. It might feel slightly scary for a woman alone coming into the hotel entrance at night, about 20 meters. I liked it~! I will come again next time. Thank you.

name: The Rizin Hotel Phratamnak
detail: The accommodation is very peaceful. It takes just a short walk to get to the beach, and it's close to 7-Eleven as well. The staff is very helpful, and the room is clean. The housekeeper comes to take out the trash every day and replenishes supplies daily. However, I have to deduct 1 point because I didn't like the smell in the bathroom. Other than that, everything is great. The room is spacious and has all the necessary amenities.
area: Phra Tamnak Hill,Pattaya - View on map

name: March Hotel
detail: I stayed in room 406 at March Hotel for 7 nights. The room is spacious and inexpensive. It is clean and well-maintained. I’m not sure how the distribution to the neighboring MAY Hotel works, but I thought either would be fine. The pool, sauna, and gym are small, but you can relax there. In the morning, you can stay at March Hotel, and in the afternoon, you can swim at the neighboring MAY Hotel to avoid direct sunlight. The motorcycle parking at MAY Hotel has a roof, so you won’t get wet in the rain. There is a convenience store, a 7-Eleven, on Second Road (about a 5-minute walk away). The front desk staff may not be very friendly, but they don’t interfere unnecessarily and will help you if you ask. You can rest well since you don’t hear any noise from the bars. There are food stalls selling pad grapow rice, porridge, and fruits that come daily for the staff, providing affordable and delicious meals. I was impressed with the prompt and careful cleaning service. I hope the prices do not increase. I am looking forward to my next visit.

name: Siam At Siam Design Hotel Pattaya
detail: Everything was really satisfactory. All the staff were kind and the service was great. I think the location is really excellent. Our room was on the 22nd floor and the view was fantastic. When I stayed in a room below the 10th floor before, it was a bit noisy because of the mall in front, but this time it was really good. However, I was disappointed that there was no smart TV in the expensive room. Of course, I could watch through smart view mirroring, but it was really regrettable not to have a smart TV. Also, I recommend bringing a filtered showerhead. I had to replace the filter every time I showered. During one shower, the filter turned to a dark brownish color. I used a single-filter showerhead, but if possible, I recommend using a dual-filter showerhead.

name: Vogue Pattaya
detail: The quality of the room, cleanliness, location, and everything regarding the price is good. In front of the hotel, there is a laundromat, and behind it, there are a bar, a Western restaurant, and a massage parlor. If you go out to the main road, there’s a Seven-Eleven as well. Even without breakfast included, it’s available for 300 baht, and the content is average. The deposit is 1000 baht. For guests, you must leave an ID. The negatives were that in the room I stayed in, the main lighting was completely missing, and the safe was broken and unusable. The noise from motorbikes on the main road in the morning was louder than at night. Overall, it was very good.

name: The Holiday Resort Pattaya
detail: I had a wonderful experience at The Holiday Resort Pattaya. The hotel has a beautiful resort atmosphere, spacious and comfortable rooms, a large swimming pool, and excellent facilities. The location is very convenient, with easy access to Central Pattaya, restaurants, shopping and the beach. The rooms were clean, comfortable and well maintained, and the overall property felt fresh and relaxing. What really made our stay special was the friendly and helpful staff. Everyone was welcoming and professional throughout our stay. The swimming pool and relaxing outdoor areas are perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring Pattaya. The food and breakfast options were also enjoyable. Overall, The Holiday Resort Pattaya is a great choice for families, couples, friends and business travellers looking for comfort, good facilities and excellent value in Pattaya. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I would definitely stay here again on my next visit to Pattaya.
